verdict.rationale: monday.com documents AI agents you can message or @mention in updates that return replies, and marketing copy says it can surface insights from any subject, which loosely covers asking AI a question about workspace work. Nothing documents a dedicated workspace Q&A or answers grounded in board content, and citations are never mentioned. missing for 10: documented Q&A over workspace content, source citations in answers, evidence of instant answer latency, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can ask AI a question and get an instant answer with citations from my workspace content

citations.quote: Talk to agents like teammates. Message them in updates, assign them items, and @mention them in any conversation to kick off real work — replies, statuses, and follow-ups included.
Surface deep intelligence and actionable insights from any subject.
